## 🟢 Level A1 — Beginner (Words 1–1000)



## A1 Part 1: Basic Objects & Everyday Nouns (1–250)

### 1. hello /interjection/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សួស្តី
1. Hello! My name is Tom.
2. She says hello to her teacher.
3. Hello! How are you?

---

### 2. goodbye /interjection/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លាហើយ
1. Goodbye! See you tomorrow.
2. He says goodbye to his friend.
3. Goodbye! Have a good day.

---

### 3. yes /adverb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បាទ / ចាស
1. Yes, I am happy.
2. Yes, this is my book.
3. She says yes to the question.

---

### 4. no /adverb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទេ / អត់
1. No, I am not tired.
2. No, this is not my bag.
3. He says no to the teacher.

---

### 5. please /adverb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សូម
1. Please open the door.
2. Can I have water, please?
3. Please sit down.

---

### 6. thank you /phrase/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អរគុណ
1. Thank you for the book.
2. She says thank you to her mother.
3. Thank you! You are very kind.

---

### 7. sorry /interjection/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សុំទោស
1. Sorry, I am late.
2. He says sorry to his friend.
3. Sorry! I do not understand.

---

### 8. I /pronoun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ខ្ញុំ
1. I am a student.
2. I have a cat.
3. I like apples.

---

### 9. you /pronoun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អ្នក / លោក / អ្នកស្រី
1. You are my friend.
2. You have a big bag.
3. Are you happy?

---

### 10. he /pronoun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** គាត់ (ប្រុស)

2. He has a dog.
3. He is tall.

---

### 11. she /pronoun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** គាត់ (ស្រី)

3. She is happy.

1. She was very excited before her first trip abroad.
2. The children were excited to see the ocean for the first time.
3. We were excited because we had been planning the trip for months.

---

### 1230. relaxed /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ស្ងប់ស្ងាត់ / ធូររលូន
1. We felt relaxed after a few days at the beach resort.
2. She was so relaxed that she almost forgot to check out on time.
3. The peaceful village made everyone feel relaxed and calm.

---

### 1231. helpful /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ជួយ / ចូលចិត្តជួយ
1. The hotel receptionist was very helpful and gave us good advice.
2. He was helpful and carried our luggage to the room.
3. The map app was very helpful when we got lost in the city.

---

### 1232. friendly /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** រាក់ទាក់ / រួសរាយ
1. The people in the village were very friendly and welcomed us warmly.
2. She loved the country because everyone was so friendly and kind.
3. The friendly staff at the hostel made us feel at home.

---

### 1233. available /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** មាន / ទំនេរ
1. Is a single room available for tonight?
2. The shuttle bus is available every thirty minutes from the airport.
3. She checked if a tour guide was available for the next day.

---

### 1234. included /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** រួមបញ្ចូល
1. Breakfast is included in the room price, so we ate at the hotel.
2. Ask the travel agent if transport is included in the tour price.
3. The ticket price included entry to all the main attractions.

---

### 1235. optional /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ស្ម័គ្រចិត្ត / ជ្រើស
1. The boat trip is optional, so you don't have to go if you don't want to.
2. Leaving a tip is optional, but it is kind if the service is good.
3. The tour guide said the evening show was optional but very popular.

---

### 1236. recommend /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ណែនាំ / ផ្ដល់ការណែនាំ
1. Can you recommend a good restaurant near the hotel?
2. She recommended a beautiful beach that most tourists don't visit.
3. The guidebook recommended visiting the market early in the morning.

---

### 1237. suggest /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ស្នើ / ណែនាំ
1. The guide suggested that we visit the temple in the morning.
2. She suggested taking the scenic route for a better experience.
3. I suggested stopping for lunch because everyone was hungry.

---

### 1238. prefer /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ចូលចិត្ត / ពេញចិត្ត
1. She prefers to travel by train because it is more comfortable than flying.
2. I prefer a window seat so I can enjoy the view.
3. He prefers budget travel, so he always stays in hostels.

---

### 1239. include /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** រួមបញ្ចូល
1. The tour includes transport, meals, and entry fees to all places.
2. Does the room price include breakfast and taxes?
3. She asked the agent to include a guided tour in the package.

---

### 1240. require /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ត្រូវការ
1. Traveling to some countries requires a visa before you arrive.
2. The campsite requires guests to book at least one week ahead.
3. Check-in requires a valid passport or ID card.

---

### 1241. allow /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អនុញ្ញាត
1. The airline does not allow liquids over 100ml in carry-on bags.
2. Photography is not allowed inside the temple.
3. The hotel allows pets in some rooms, so she brought her dog.

---

### 1242. forbid /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ហាមឃាត់
1. Smoking is forbidden in all areas of the airport.
2. The sign said it was forbidden to walk on the grass.
3. Loud music is forbidden in the hostel after ten o'clock at night.

---

### 1243. carry /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្ទុក / ដឹក
1. She carried all her things in a small backpack on the trip.
2. The porter offered to carry our luggage to the room.
3. Always carry a copy of your passport when you go out.

---

### 1244. wait /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** រង់ចាំ
1. We waited at the bus stop for twenty minutes before it arrived.
2. She waited in the queue at immigration for a long time.
3. He waited at the arrivals hall until he saw his family.

---

### 1245. hurry /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:**서ប់ / ប្រញ
1. We had to hurry because our bus was leaving in ten minutes.
2. She hurried through the airport to reach her gate on time.
3. Hurry up! The tour guide is waiting for us outside.

---

### 1246. miss /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ខក / ខកខាន
1. We almost missed our train because we got lost in the station.
2. She missed the last bus and had to take a taxi instead.
3. He was sad because he missed the sunrise over the mountains.

---

### 1247. reach /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ដល់ / ទៅដល់
1. We finally reached the summit of the hill after two hours of walking.
2. The taxi reached the airport just in time for boarding.
3. She reached the hotel and immediately went to the pool.

---

### 1248. return /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ត្រឡប់ / ត្រឡប់ទៅ
1. We returned to the hotel after a long day of sightseeing.
2. She returned her rental car before catching the flight home.
3. He was happy to return home and see his family again.

---

### 1249. relax /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សម្រាក / ស្ងប់ស្ងាត់
1. We relaxed by the pool after a busy week of sightseeing.
2. She sat on the beach and relaxed while listening to the waves.
3. It is important to relax and enjoy the holiday without rushing.

---

### 1250. enjoy /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** រីករាយ / ពេញចិត្ត
1. We enjoyed every moment of our holiday at the beach resort.
2. She enjoyed the local food and tried something new every day.
3. They enjoyed the trip so much that they decided to come back next year.

---


## A2 Part 2: Shopping, Food & Services (1251–1500)

### 1251. supermarket /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្សារទំនើប
1. I go to the supermarket every Saturday to buy food.
2. The supermarket has many different kinds of fruit and vegetables.
3. My mother buys milk and bread at the supermarket near our house.

---

### 1252. market /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្សារ
1. We go to the market early in the morning to get fresh food.
2. The market is very busy on weekends because many people shop there.
3. I bought some vegetables and fish at the local market.

---

### 1253. shop /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ហាង
1. There is a small shop near my school that sells snacks.
2. I like to go to the shop with my friends after school.
3. The shop closes at nine o'clock every night.

---

### 1254. store /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ហាងលក់ទំនិញ
1. My father works in a big store in the city center.
2. The store sells clothes, shoes, and bags at good prices.
3. I found a nice jacket at the store, but it was too expensive.

---

### 1255. bakery /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ហាងនំប៉័ង
1. I buy fresh bread from the bakery every morning.
2. The bakery near my house smells very good because of the cakes.
3. My sister works at a bakery and she makes delicious pastries.

---

### 1256. butcher /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អ្នកលក់សាច់ / ហាងលក់សាច់
1. My mother goes to the butcher to buy fresh chicken and beef.
2. The butcher cuts the meat into small pieces for us.
3. There is a good butcher at the end of our street.

---

### 1257. pharmacy /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ឱសថស្ថាន
1. I went to the pharmacy to buy medicine for my cold.
2. The pharmacy opens at eight o'clock in the morning.
3. You can buy vitamins and painkillers at the pharmacy.

---

### 1258. bookshop /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ហាងលក់សៀវភៅ
1. I bought a new English dictionary at the bookshop downtown.
2. The bookshop has a large section for children's books.
3. My friend works part-time at a bookshop near the university.

---

### 1259. clothes shop /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ហាងលក់សម្លៀកបំពាក់
1. I bought a new dress at the clothes shop in the mall.
2. The clothes shop has a sale this week, so everything is cheaper.
3. My sister loves going to the clothes shop on weekends.

---

### 1260. department store /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ហាងធំ (ដែលលក់ទំនិញច្រើនប្រភេទ)
1. The department store sells food, clothes, and electronics on different floors.
2. We spent the whole afternoon at the department store because it is so big.
3. I bought a gift for my mother at the department store last Sunday.

---

### 1261. shopping center /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** មជ្ឈមណ្ឌលពាណិជ្ជកម្ម
1. The new shopping center has over one hundred shops inside.
2. We meet our friends at the shopping center every Friday evening.
3. There is a cinema and a food court in the shopping center.

---

### 1262. mall /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** មជ្ឈមណ្ឌលផ្សារទំនើប
1. My family goes to the mall to shop and have lunch together.
2. The mall is air-conditioned, so it is a cool place on hot days.
3. I saw many international brands at the mall in the city.

---

### 1263. counter /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** តុបុ៉ស្ត / តុបន្ទប់ (សេវាកម្ម)
1. Please go to the counter to pay for your items.
2. The cashier at the counter gave me my change quickly.
3. I waited at the counter for ten minutes before someone helped me.

---

### 1264. shelf /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ធ្នើ
1. The books are on the shelf next to the window.
2. The cereal boxes are on the top shelf at the supermarket.
3. I put the new plates on the shelf in the kitchen.

---

### 1265. basket /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កន្ត្រក
1. I put some apples and bread in my basket at the market.
2. The shopping basket was heavy because I bought a lot of food.
3. She carried a small basket with flowers to the party.

---

### 1266. trolley /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** រទេះដើរផ្សារ
1. I used a trolley at the supermarket because I bought many things.
2. The trolley was full of groceries by the time we finished shopping.
3. Please return the trolley to the front of the store after you finish.

---

### 1267. cashier /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អ្នកគិតលុយ
1. The cashier counted my money and gave me the right change.
2. I waited in line because the cashier was busy with another customer.
3. The cashier smiled and asked if I had a loyalty card.

---

### 1268. receipt /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វិក្កយបត្រទទួលប្រាក់
1. Please keep your receipt if you want to return the item later.
2. The cashier gave me a receipt after I paid for my groceries.
3. I checked the receipt and found that I was charged the wrong price.

---

### 1269. bag /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កាប់ / ថង់
1. I carry my books in a blue bag every day at school.
2. Can you please put my shopping in a bag?
3. She bought a leather bag as a birthday gift for her friend.

---

### 1270. box /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រអប់
1. I packed my old clothes into a big box to donate.
2. There is a box of chocolates on the kitchen table.
3. The cereal comes in a colorful box with a picture of fruits on it.

---

### 1271. package /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កញ្ចប់
1. I received a package from my cousin who lives abroad.

3. Please wrap the package carefully before you send it.

---

### 1272. weight /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទំងន់
1. The seller put the fruit on the scale to check its weight.
2. I need to know the weight of this bag before I can ship it.
3. The weight of the package is two kilograms.

---

### 1273. gram /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ក្រាម
1. This recipe needs two hundred grams of flour and one egg.

3. I only need fifty grams of butter to make the cookies.

---

### 1274. kilogram /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** គីឡូក្រាម
1. I bought two kilograms of rice at the market today.
2. One kilogram of apples costs three dollars at the supermarket.
3. My bag is heavy because it weighs over ten kilograms.

---

### 1275. liter /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លីត្រ
1. Please buy two liters of milk when you go to the store.

3. The bottle contains one and a half liters of orange juice.

---

### 1276. dozen /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ដូហ្សែន (ចំនួន ១២)
1. I bought a dozen eggs at the market this morning.
2. My mother ordered two dozen cupcakes for the birthday party.
3. A dozen oranges cost about four dollars at the fruit stand.

---

### 1277. piece /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កំណាត់ / ដុំ
1. Can I have a piece of cake, please?

### 1278. slice /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ចំណិត

### 1279. portion /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្នែក / ចំណែក (អាហារ)

### 1280. meal /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អាហារ (ពេល)
1. Breakfast is my favorite meal of the day because I love eggs and toast.
2. Our family eats a meal together every evening at six o'clock.
3. She cooked a big meal for her friends on Sunday afternoon.

---

### 1281. breakfast /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អាហារពេលព្រឹក
1. I always eat breakfast before I go to school.

### 1282. lunch /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អាហារពេលថ្ងៃ

### 1283. dinner /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អាហារពេលល្ងាច

### 1284. snack /noun/

### 1285. dessert /noun/

### 1286. soup /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សុប

### 1287. salad /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សាឡាត់

### 1288. sandwich /noun/

### 1291. pasta /noun/

### 1292. noodle /noun/

### 1293. sushi /noun/

### 1294. curry /noun/

### 1296. roast /noun/

### 1297. grill /verb/

### 1298. fry /verb/

### 1299. boil /verb/

### 1300. bake /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ដុត (នំ ។ល។)

### 1301. steam /verb/

### 1302. mix /verb/

### 2250. pivot /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្លាស់ប្ដូរទិសដៅ (ក្នុងអាជីវកម្ម)

## 🔴 Level B2 — Upper Intermediate (Words 3501–5000)



## 🔴 Level B2 — Upper Intermediate (Words 3501–5000)

### B2 Part 1: Academic Language (3501–3750)

### 3501. analyze /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វិភាគ
1. If researchers analyze the statistical data thoroughly, they will identify patterns that were previously overlooked.
2. The committee cannot reach a sound decision until all submitted laboratory samples are analyzed independently.
3. Although the software is designed to analyze complex demographic trends, human oversight is still required to interpret subtle anomalies.

---

### 3502. synthesize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សំយោគ
1. In order to complete the dissertation, students must synthesize findings from dozens of peer-reviewed articles into a unified framework.
2. If you do not synthesize your sources effectively, your literature review will read like a disjointed list of summaries.
3. The conference aims to synthesize various theoretical perspectives that have emerged across different social science disciplines.

---

### 3503. evaluate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វាយតម្លៃ
1. Before any curriculum changes are implemented, educators must carefully evaluate their potential impact on student performance.
2. If independent auditors evaluate the project proposals, funding will be allocated much more objectively.
3. The study was designed to evaluate whether cognitive behavioral interventions could produce lasting psychological benefits.

---

### 3504. assess /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វាយតម្លៃ / កត់សម្គាល់កម្រិត
1. Unless the board assesses the environmental risks beforehand, the construction project may face significant regulatory penalties.
2. Psychologists use standardized testing instruments to assess verbal reasoning skills in bilingual children.
3. If we assess the long-term feasibility of the proposal, we can determine whether additional resources will be needed.

---

### 3505. justify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បញ្ជាក់ហេតុផល / ផ្ដល់សំអាង
1. The author failed to provide adequate empirical evidence to justify the sweeping conclusions presented in the final chapter.
2. If an investigator proposes an intrusive experimental method, they must justify why less disruptive alternatives were rejected.
3. Scholars are expected to justify their methodological choices when defending their dissertations before the academic committee.

---

### 3506. argue /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លើកហេតុផលតវ៉ា
1. Several prominent economists argue that inflation cannot be controlled without tightening fiscal policy across the eurozone.
2. If the defense attorney argues that the evidence was mishandled, the judge might dismiss the entire case.
3. Although many commentators argue that technology reduces social interaction, recent sociological studies suggest a more nuanced picture.

---

### 3507. contend /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រកែក / អះអាង
1. Proponents of the new theory contend that quantum effects play an essential role in biological processes.
2. If rival researchers contend that the initial calculations were flawed, a public academic debate will likely ensue.
3. The authors contend that institutional inequality cannot be dismantled unless systemic reforms are simultaneously enacted.

---

### 3508. assert /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បញ្ជាក់អះអាង
1. The lead scientist asserted that the new compound exhibited significant antimicrobial activity without causing cytotoxicity.
2. If you assert a controversial thesis in academic writing, you must substantiate it with verifiable empirical data.
3. Critics asserted that the policy had been implemented prematurely before adequate pilot testing was conducted.

---

### 3509. claim /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អះអាង
1. Although the pharmaceutical manufacturer claims that the medication has no side effects, clinical trials suggest otherwise.
2. If an author claims that a correlation implies causation, the peer reviewers will almost certainly reject the manuscript.
3. Scholars who claim that ancient civilizations possessed advanced metallurgy must produce concrete archaeological evidence.

---

### 3510. hypothesize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ដាក់សម្មតិកម្ម
1. The research team hypothesized that exposure to natural daylight would enhance cognitive focus among office workers.
2. If we hypothesize that genetic factors outweigh environmental influences, our experimental model must isolate those variables.
3. Neuroscientists hypothesized that memory consolidation occurs predominantly during specific stages of deep sleep.

---

### 3511. theorize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បង្កើតទ្រឹស្តី
1. Astrophysicists theorize that dark matter comprises a substantial portion of the total mass in the observable universe.
2. If sociologists theorize about modern urbanization, they must take digital connectivity and remote work into account.
3. Early philosophers theorized that matter consisted of indivisible particles long before atomic structure was experimentally confirmed.

---

### 3512. postulate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សន្មតជាគោលការណ៍
1. The economic model postulates that consumers will always behave rationally when maximizing personal utility.
2. If researchers postulate that cultural values dictate consumer spending, they must test this assumption across diverse societies.
3. Linguists postulate that all human languages share an underlying structural blueprint known as universal grammar.

---

### 3513. demonstrate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បង្ហាញ / បញ្ជាក់បង្ហាញ
1. The laboratory experiments clearly demonstrated that the catalyst significantly accelerated the chemical reaction rate.
2. If future trials demonstrate the efficacy of the vaccine, health authorities will grant emergency authorization.
3. By presenting comprehensive comparative graphs, the speaker demonstrated how renewable energy costs have plummeted over the last decade.

---

### 3514. illustrate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ពន្យល់ដោយឧទាហរណ៍ / បង្ហាញ
1. The professor used historical case studies to illustrate how economic embargoes often produce unintended humanitarian consequences.
2. If diagrams are included to illustrate the biochemical pathway, undergraduate students will grasp the concept much faster.
3. The report illustrates the stark disparities in healthcare access that persist between rural and urban communities.

---

### 3515. exemplify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លើកជាគំរូ
1. The rapid development of mRNA vaccines exemplifies how international scientific collaboration can yield breakthrough innovations.
2. If an institution aims to exemplify excellence in teaching, it must provide continuous pedagogical support to its faculty.
3. The novelist's intricate narrative structure exemplifies the core aesthetic tenets of modernist literature.

---

### 3516. elaborate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លម្អិតបន្ថែម
1. The presenter was requested to elaborate on the statistical methodology that had been applied during the third phase of the trial.
2. If you do not elaborate on your theoretical framework, readers may struggle to understand your analytical perspective.
3. In the subsequent chapter, the author elaborates on how macroeconomic instability contributed to the political crisis.

---

### 3517. clarify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បំភ្លឺឱ្យច្បាស់
1. The editor requested that the researchers clarify their operational definitions before the article could be accepted for publication.
2. If the instructions do not clarify the grading rubric, students might submit assignments that fail to meet academic standards.
3. The government spokesperson issued a detailed statement to clarify how the new taxation laws would affect university endowments.

---

### 3518. specify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បញ្ជាក់ជាក់លាក់
1. Academic guidelines specify that all direct quotations must include the exact page number from the original source.
2. If the contract does not specify the timeline for project deliverables, disputes may arise between the collaborating institutions.
3. The research protocol clearly specifies which exclusion criteria should be applied when screening potential volunteers.

---

### 3519. define /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កំណត់និយមន័យ
1. Before launching an empirical investigation, researchers must clearly define the operational variables they intend to measure.
2. If sociologists define poverty solely through income metrics, they will fail to capture multidimensional aspects of deprivation.
3. The introductory chapter defines several technical terms that appear frequently throughout the specialized discourse.

---

### 3520. categorize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ចាត់ជាជំពូក / បែងចែកក្រុម
1. The archivists categorized historical manuscripts according to their geographical origin, language, and estimated date of creation.
2. If we categorize respondents into distinct age cohorts, we can observe generational shifts in political attitudes.
3. Botanists use morphological features to categorize newly discovered plant specimens into appropriate taxonomic families.

---

### 3521. classify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ចាត់ថ្នាក់
1. Medical pathologists classify tumors based on their histological characteristics and biological behavior.
2. If machine learning algorithms classify customer feedback accurately, support teams can resolve critical issues more efficiently.
3. The library system classifies non-fiction volumes according to the Dewey Decimal Classification system.

---

### 3522. compare /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រៀបធៀប
1. The objective of the paper was to compare educational outcomes between public institutions and private charter schools.
2. If analysts compare the current economic indicators with those of 2008, significant structural differences become apparent.
3. Scholars frequently compare democratic transitions across Eastern Europe to determine common institutional catalysts.

---

### 3523. contrast /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រៀបធៀបភាពផ្ទុយគ្នា
1. The author contrasts centralized administrative systems with decentralized governance models to demonstrate their relative efficiency.
2. If you contrast qualitative interviews with quantitative surveys, you will recognize the unique strengths and limitations of each method.
3. The essay contrasts the optimistic outlook of Enlightenment thinkers with the skepticism of twentieth-century existentialists.

---

### 3524. distinguish /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ញែកឱ្យដាច់ / បែងចែក
1. It is essential to distinguish between empirical correlation and direct causation when interpreting statistical models.
2. If clinicians cannot distinguish viral infections from bacterial pathogens, they may prescribe unnecessary antibiotic treatments.
3. Philosophers often distinguish normative ethical theories from descriptive accounts of moral behavior.

---

### 3525. differentiate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កំណត់ភាពខុសគ្នា
1. Advanced diagnostic tools allow physicians to differentiate between benign lesions and malignant growths with high precision.
2. If consumer brands fail to differentiate their products in crowded markets, their profit margins will steadily decline.
3. The study attempted to differentiate the psychological effects of acute stress from those caused by chronic exhaustion.

---

### 3526. identify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កំណត់អត្តសញ្ញាណ / រកឃើញ
1. Through genetic sequencing, molecular biologists identified several mutations responsible for inherited cardiac conditions.
2. If inspectors identify compliance violations during the audit, the facility will be subject to substantial administrative fines.
3. The survey was conducted to identify the primary factors that influence voter turnout among young demographics.

---

### 3527. examine /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ពិនិត្យពិច័យ
1. The parliamentary commission was appointed to examine whether existing data privacy laws are adequate in the era of artificial intelligence.
2. If scholars examine historical archival documents carefully, they will discover forgotten perspectives on the peace negotiations.
3. This chapter examines how socio-economic background continues to influence higher education attainment in developed nations.

---

### 3528. investigate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ស៊ើបអង្កេត / ស្រាវជ្រាវ
1. Epidemiologists were sent to investigate the sudden outbreak of respiratory illness in the industrial district.
2. If the university ethics board decides to investigate the allegations, all ongoing experimental protocols will be paused.
3. A multidisciplinary team was assembled to investigate how ocean warming affects coral reef biodiversity.

---

### 3529. explore /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** រុករក / ស្វែងយល់
1. The seminar will explore how philosophical concepts of justice have evolved from antiquity to the contemporary era.
2. If we explore alternative renewable energy technologies, we might find cost-effective solutions for rural electrification.
3. Sociologists conducted in-depth interviews to explore the lived experiences of immigrants navigating foreign labor markets.

---

### 3530. consider /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ពិចារណា
1. When formulating environmental policies, governments must consider both immediate economic costs and intergenerational equity.
2. If you consider the experimental limitations described by the authors, the statistical conclusions become far less convincing.
3. The committee agreed to consider revised grant applications provided that applicants addressed the reviewers' methodological concerns.

---

### 3531. acknowledge /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទទួលស្គាល់
1. In the final section of the paper, the authors acknowledge that their sample size was too small to make definitive generalizations.
2. If researchers do not acknowledge previous scholarly contributions, they risk being accused of academic negligence.
3. The dean acknowledged that significant funding cuts had severely compromised the department's ability to maintain research laboratories.

---

### 3532. recognize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទទួលស្គាល់ / មើលឃើញ
1. International academic bodies recognize peer review as the foundational standard for evaluating scholarly validity.
2. If institutions fail to recognize diverse learning styles, a substantial percentage of students may underperform academically.
3. Historians recognize that the Treaty of Versailles contained unresolved tensions that contributed to future global conflicts.

---

### 3533. attribute /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ចាត់ទុកថាជា / សំអាងទៅលើ
1. Climatologists attribute the rising frequency of extreme weather events to anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions.
2. If historians attribute the empire's downfall solely to military defeat, they will overlook critical economic vulnerabilities.
3. The sudden increase in test scores was attributed to the newly introduced interactive tutoring program.

---

### 3534. correlate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** មានទំនាក់ទំនងគ្នា
1. Epidemiological studies indicate that regular aerobic exercise correlates strongly with lower incidences of cardiovascular disease.
2. If high levels of stress correlate with decreased immune function, interventions aimed at stress reduction could improve patient recovery.
3. Statistical analyses showed that socioeconomic status correlates positively with access to advanced placement courses.

---

### 3535. associate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្សារភ្ជាប់
1. Public health campaigns frequently associate excessive refined sugar consumption with heightened risks of metabolic syndrome.
2. If researchers associate specific cognitive deficits with localized brain trauma, targeted rehabilitation therapies can be developed.
3. Many sociologists associate rapid industrialization with the decline of traditional agrarian family structures.

---

### 3536. infer /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទាញសេចក្តីសន្និដ្ឋានដោយប្រយោល
1. From the fossil records discovered in the sedimentary layer, paleontologists could infer the prevailing climatic conditions of that epoch.
2. If readers infer intentions that the author never expressed, literary criticism becomes an exercise in subjective interpretation.
3. Economists inferred from consumer spending patterns that public confidence in the financial recovery remained relatively fragile.

---

### 3537. deduce /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទាញរកសេចក្តីសន្និដ្ឋាន
1. By analyzing the chemical residue on the pottery fragments, archaeologists deduced the culinary practices of the ancient settlement.
2. If we accept the initial mathematical premises as true, we can logically deduce the remaining theorems through rigorous proofs.
3. Investigators were able to deduce the cause of the structural failure after examining the microscopic fractures in the steel beams.

---

### 3538. conclude /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សន្និដ្ឋាន
1. After examining all empirical data, the researchers concluded that the intervention had produced no statistically significant difference.
2. If the clinical trial concludes that the drug is both safe and effective, commercial distribution will commence next quarter.
3. The review panel concluded that while the methodology was sound, the author's theoretical assertions required further corroboration.

---

### 3539. verify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
1. Independent laboratories were contracted to verify whether the experimental results could be reproduced under identical parameters.
2. If fact-checkers verify that the cited data points are inaccurate, the publication will be required to issue a formal retraction.
3. Before any financial disbursements are approved, the compliance department must verify all receipts and documentation.

---

### 3540. validate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ធ្វើឱ្យមានសុពលភាព
1. The psychometric assessment was administered to a national sample of five thousand students to validate its measurement accuracy.
2. If peer reviewers validate the mathematical proof, it will represent one of the major theoretical breakthroughs of the decade.
3. Subsequent clinical studies helped to validate the diagnostic criteria that had been formulated by the international psychiatric panel.

---

### 3541. refute /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ច្រានចោល / បដិសេធ
1. The economist presented extensive historical evidence to refute the assertion that trade tariffs inevitably protect domestic wages.
2. If the experimental findings refute the hypothesis, the research group must formulate an alternative theoretical explanation.
3. Several replicated trials have refuted the earlier claim that mega-doses of vitamin C can cure viral infections.

---

### 3542. contradict /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្ទុយនឹង
1. The latest astronomical observations contradict the theoretical models that had predicted a slower cosmic expansion rate.
2. If witness testimony contradicts physical evidence gathered at the scene, forensic experts must re-examine their timeline.
3. The survey results directly contradict the administration's belief that employee morale had improved over the previous quarter.

---

### 3543. challenge /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រឈម / ចោទសួរ
1. Recent archaeological discoveries challenge the longstanding consensus that human settlement of the region began ten thousand years ago.
2. If progressive scholars challenge traditional historical paradigms, they must provide compelling archival documentation to support their stance.
3. The lawsuit challenged the university's admissions criteria on the grounds that they unfairly disadvantaged minority applicants.

---

### 3544. question /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ចោទសួរមន្ទិល
1. Several prominent bioethicists began to question whether gene editing in human embryos could ever be justified without broad societal consensus.
2. If reviewers question the transparency of your sampling technique, you should provide raw anonymized data in an appendix.
3. The editorial questioned the validity of government statistics regarding unemployment figures during the economic crisis.

---

### 3545. critique /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** រិះគន់បែបស្ថាបនា
1. In his latest monograph, the philosopher critiques contemporary postmodernist thought for abandoning objective standards of truth.
2. If graduate students critique one another's draft chapters constructively, the overall quality of scholarship will improve markedly.
3. The journal invited several distinguished scholars to critique the groundbreaking article from differing theoretical perspectives.

---

### 3546. review /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ពិនិត្យឡើងវិញ
1. The departmental committee meets every semester to review the curriculum and align course objectives with evolving industry needs.
2. If the institutional review board reviews the clinical proposal promptly, patient recruitment can begin by early spring.
3. Scholars must critically review existing literature before formulating their research questions to avoid duplicating previous studies.

---

### 3547. revise /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កែសម្រួល / កែលម្អ
1. Authors were given three months to revise their manuscript in accordance with the suggestions provided by the peer reviewers.
2. If the government revises the tax code, universities may face significant alterations in how philanthropic donations are treated.
3. The textbook was thoroughly revised to incorporate recent advancements in molecular genetics and bioinformatics.

---

### 3548. modify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កែប្រែ
1. The engineers had to modify the experimental apparatus so that it could withstand extreme atmospheric pressures during testing.
2. If researchers modify the established protocol without ethical approval, the entire dataset may be deemed inadmissible.
3. The software was modified to ensure that survey responses were encrypted and stored securely on cloud servers.

---

### 3549. adapt /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សម្របតាម
1. Educators had to adapt their instructional strategies when university courses were abruptly shifted to online platforms.
2. If developing nations adapt sustainable agricultural technologies, they can enhance food security while preserving water tables.
3. The research framework was adapted from industrial psychology to investigate interpersonal dynamics within healthcare teams.

---

### 3550. apply /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អនុវត្ត
1. Theoretical physicists often apply complex topological mathematics to solve problems related to quantum field theory.
2. If students learn how to apply statistical reasoning to everyday arguments, they will become more discerning consumers of media information.
3. The framework was applied across three diverse case studies to test whether its analytical power remained consistent.

---

### 3551. implement /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អនុវត្តជាក់ស្តែង
1. If municipal authorities implement the recommended traffic restrictions, air quality will improve dramatically within six months.
2. The university plans to implement a new plagiarism detection protocol before the commencement of the autumn semester.
3. Although the theoretical model seemed promising, engineers struggled to implement it under realistic industrial constraints.

---

### 3552. execute /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រតិបត្តិ / អនុវត្ត
1. The laboratory team executed the complex chemical synthesis with meticulous precision to avoid accidental contamination.
2. If project managers do not execute the clinical trial according to strict regulatory standards, the data will be invalidated.
3. Researchers must carefully plan every stage of fieldwork before they execute interviews in remote indigenous communities.

---

### 3553. formulate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បង្កើតឡើង / រៀបចំបង្កើត
1. Before beginning data collection, scientists must formulate clear hypotheses that can be tested empirically.
2. If the committee formulates policy guidelines without public consultation, community resistance will likely undermine their adoption.
3. The economist formulated a mathematical equation that accounts for inflation expectations and consumer debt burdens.

---

### 3554. articulate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បញ្ចេញមតិយ៉ាងច្បាស់លាស់
1. Graduate students are expected to articulate their research questions clearly during oral dissertation defenses.
2. If the author does not articulate the conceptual distinction between equity and equality, readers may misunderstand the central thesis.
3. The spokesperson struggled to articulate how the proposed budget cuts would preserve high educational standards.

---

### 3555. incorporate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បញ្ចូលគ្នា
1. The revised edition incorporates feedback from international reviewers who evaluated the first printing of the monograph.
2. If teachers incorporate active learning strategies into their curriculum, student retention rates will likely increase.
3. The research framework was designed to incorporate both quantitative economic metrics and qualitative ethnographic observations.

---

### 3556. integrate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ធ្វើសមាហរណកម្ម / បញ្ចូលគ្នា
1. Modern climate models integrate oceanographic, atmospheric, and terrestrial data to generate accurate forecasts.
2. If educational institutions integrate digital literacy across all academic disciplines, graduates will be better prepared for modern careers.
3. The study demonstrates how traditional indigenous knowledge can be integrated with contemporary conservation science.

---

### 3557. contextualize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ដាក់ក្នុងបរិបទ
1. To interpret ancient historical documents accurately, scholars must contextualize the socio-political environment in which they were written.
2. If commentators fail to contextualize unemployment statistics, the public may misjudge the true health of the labor market.
3. The professor contextualized the author's philosophical arguments by examining the turbulent wartime conditions of that era.

---

### 3558. interpret /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បកស្រាយ
1. Because cultural norms vary significantly, researchers must interpret interview responses with extreme caution.
2. If economists interpret short-term price fluctuations as permanent structural shifts, their policy advice could be disastrous.
3. The qualitative analyst was hired to interpret the thematic patterns that emerged from hundreds of focus group transcripts.

---

### 3559. substantiate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្តល់ភស្តុតាងបញ្ជាក់
1. The historian failed to substantiate his controversial claims with primary archival documentation.
2. If a scholar cannot substantiate an empirical assertion, reviewers will recommend that the manuscript be rejected.
3. Subsequent forensic examinations substantiated the initial hypothesis that structural flaws caused the bridge collapse.

---

### 3560. corroborate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បញ្ជាក់បន្ថែមឱ្យរឹងមាំ
1. Independent witness testimonies corroborated the laboratory findings, providing compelling proof of industrial pollution.
2. If satellite imagery corroborates the ground reports, international observers will verify that deforestation has escalated.
3. The clinical trial results were corroborated by two independent research centers operating under identical protocols.

---

### 3561. dispute /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រកែកតវ៉ា
1. Several climatologists dispute the methodology used in the corporate report, arguing that emissions were severely underestimated.
2. If the labor union disputes the validity of the productivity metrics, contract negotiations may reach an impasse.
3. Historians continue to dispute whether the economic blockade was the primary catalyst for the regime's collapse.

---

### 3562. generalize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទាញជាគោលការណ៍ទូទៅ
1. Researchers should not generalize findings from a small non-representative sample to the entire national population.
2. If sociologists generalize findings without controlling for geographic variables, their theoretical conclusions will remain fragile.
3. The author warned that while the case study provided valuable insights, one cannot generalize its outcomes to all post-war societies.

---

### 3563. extrapolate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប៉ាន់ស្មានផ្អែកលើទិន្នន័យ
1. By analyzing past consumption trends, analysts extrapolated future energy demand for the upcoming two decades.
2. If you extrapolate findings from a three-month study to a lifetime prognosis, the margin of error will be unacceptably wide.
3. Demographers extrapolated that urban populations in developing countries will double if current migration rates continue.

---

### 3564. simulate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ធ្វើត្រាប់តាម / ក្លែងធ្វើ
1. Supercomputers were used to simulate atmospheric circulation patterns under various carbon emission scenarios.

3. The training program uses virtual reality to simulate complex surgical procedures for medical interns.

---

### 3565. quantify /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វាស់វែងជាបរិមាណ
1. It is exceedingly difficult to quantify the intangible cultural benefits of preserving historic architectural landmarks.
2. If economists can quantify the negative externalities of fossil fuel consumption, governments can set appropriate carbon taxes.
3. The psychometric tool was developed to quantify emotional resilience among individuals recovering from severe trauma.

---

### 3566. summarize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សង្ខេប
1. In the concluding paragraph, the author summarizes the main empirical findings and outlines directions for future inquiry.
2. If you summarize previous scholarship too briefly, readers may not understand the context of your research question.
3. The policy brief summarizes complex geopolitical analyses into concise recommendations for executive decision-makers.

---

### 3567. paraphrase /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សរសេរពន្យល់ឡើងវិញតាមពាក្យផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន
1. Students must learn how to paraphrase source material accurately rather than relying on excessive direct quotations.
2. If an author paraphrases another researcher's intellectual ideas without proper attribution, it constitutes academic misconduct.
3. The literature review paraphrased complex theoretical arguments into accessible prose for multidisciplinary readers.

---

### 3568. replicate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ធ្វើឡើងវិញដើម្បីផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
1. Scientific credibility relies on whether independent laboratories can replicate experimental results under identical parameters.
2. If subsequent investigators fail to replicate the original psychological findings, the validity of the theory will be questioned.
3. The research team attempted to replicate the battery experiment using lower-cost semiconductor materials.

---

### 3569. delineate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** គូសបញ្ជាក់ព្រំដែន / រៀបរាប់លម្អិត
1. The project proposal clearly delineates the specific responsibilities of each academic partner institution.
2. If the contract does not delineate the boundary between collaborative work and proprietary research, intellectual disputes may occur.
3. The opening chapter delineates the philosophical scope of the treatise, distinguishing it from earlier utilitarian frameworks.

---

### 3570. elucidate /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ពន្យល់បំភ្លឺឱ្យច្បាស់
1. The keynote speaker sought to elucidate the subtle biological mechanisms underlying neurodegenerative disorders.
2. If the author can elucidate how systemic discrimination perpetuates economic inequality, the paper will make a vital contribution.
3. Recent structural crystallography studies have helped to elucidate how the enzyme binds with cellular receptors.

---

### 3571. scrutinize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ពិនិត្យយ៉ាងល្អិតល្អន់
1. Peer reviewers scrutinized the mathematical proofs for several weeks before confirming that no calculation errors were present.
2. If regulatory authorities scrutinize the clinical trial documentation, they may find discrepancies in adverse event reporting.
3. Journalists scrutinized the government's spending accounts, uncovering millions in unverified consultancy contracts.

---

### 3572. emphasize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សង្កត់ធ្ងន់
1. The report emphasizes that socioeconomic inequality cannot be resolved through educational reforms alone.
2. If professors emphasize critical thinking over rote memorization, students will develop more adaptable problem-solving skills.
3. The author emphasizes that climate adaptation policies must be formulated in close partnership with local communities.

---

### 3573. highlight /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លើកយកមកបង្ហាញឱ្យលេចធ្លោ
1. The executive summary highlights the most urgent policy interventions needed to mitigate water scarcity in the region.
2. If your presentation highlights only favorable data, audience members may perceive your findings as biased or incomplete.
3. The investigative article highlighted systemic failures in elderly care homes during the height of the epidemic.

---

### 3574. prioritize /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្តល់អាទិភាព
1. Due to limited grant funding, the department had to prioritize research initiatives with immediate clinical applicability.
2. If governments prioritize short-term electoral gains over long-term infrastructure investment, national productivity will stagnate.
3. Public health officials must prioritize vulnerable elderly populations when distributing initial supplies of the new antiviral medication.

---

### 3575. discard /verb/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បោះបង់ចោល / មិនយកមកប្រើ
1. Researchers had to discard the contaminated laboratory samples, which delayed the publication of their study by several months.
2. If statistical outliers are discarded without documented scientific rationale, the validity of the analysis will be compromised.
3. The theoretical model was discarded after empirical tests conclusively demonstrated that its core assumptions were false.

---

### 3576. methodology /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វិធីសាស្ត្រស្រាវជ្រាវ
1. The paper was praised for its rigorous methodology, which combined extensive ethnographic fieldwork with advanced regression analysis.
2. If the research methodology is flawed from the outset, no amount of statistical manipulation can salvage the credibility of the results.
3. Reviewers raised serious concerns regarding whether the proposed survey methodology could effectively reach rural populations.

---

### 3577. approach /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វិធីសាស្ត្រឈានទៅរក
1. The interdisciplinary approach adopted by the team enabled them to analyze urban migration through both sociological and economic lenses.
2. If researchers adopt a purely quantitative approach, they may miss profound experiential nuances captured through qualitative interviews.
3. A holistic approach to public health requires addressing social determinants of health alongside medical interventions.

---

### 3578. framework /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ក្របខ័ណ្ឌការងារ
1. The theoretical framework introduced in the opening chapter provides the analytical lens through which all empirical data is examined.
2. If the institutional framework lacks clear oversight mechanisms, administrative corruption will inevitably flourish.
3. Scholars developed a conceptual framework that helps policymakers evaluate trade-offs between economic expansion and conservation.

---

### 3579. paradigm /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** គំរូទស្សនវិជ្ជា / គំរូទ្រឹស្តី
1. The discovery of plate tectonics represented a fundamental paradigm shift that transformed modern geological science.
2. If the prevailing economic paradigm fails to explain recurring financial bubbles, alternative theories will gain mainstream acceptance.
3. Thomas Kuhn argued that scientific revolutions occur when an existing paradigm can no longer resolve accumulated experimental anomalies.

---

### 3580. perspective /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទស្សនវិស័យ / មុំមើល
1. Analyzing historical events from a post-colonial perspective reveals perspectives that were systematically suppressed in traditional archives.
2. If students are exposed to diverse cultural perspectives, their capacity for critical empathy and nuanced reasoning expands significantly.
3. From an epidemiological perspective, preventive vaccination programs remain far more cost-effective than managing chronic disease outbreaks.

---

### 3581. viewpoint /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទស្សនៈ
1. The debate featured scholars representing opposing ideological viewpoints regarding the role of state intervention in free markets.

### 3582. stance /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ជំហរ
1. The university administration maintained an uncompromising stance on academic honesty, expelling any student found guilty of cheating.

### 3583. position /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ជំហរ / គោលជំហរ

### 3584. argument /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អំណះអំណាង
1. The central argument of the book is that political stability depends far more on legal institutions than on natural resource wealth.

### 3585. counter-argument /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អំណះអំណាងប្រឆាំង

### 3588. assumption /noun/

### 3589. hypothesis /noun/

### 3591. concept /noun/

### 3593. rationale /noun/

### 3594. justification /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការបញ្ជាក់ពីភាពត្រឹមត្រូវ

### 3595. criterion /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លក្ខណៈវិនិច្ឆ័យ

### 3596. dimension /noun/

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អថេរ

### 3599. scope /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វិសាលភាព

### 3611. objectivity /noun/

### 3619. research /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការស្រាវជ្រាវ

2. If institutions do not allocate sufficient funding for basic research, long-term technological innovation will inevitably stall.
3. Her doctoral research explored how bilingual upbringing influences cognitive flexibility and executive functioning across the lifespan.

---

### 3620. study /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការសិក្សាស្រាវជ្រាវ
1. A longitudinal study conducted over thirty years revealed that chronic sleep deprivation significantly accelerates cardiovascular decline.
2. If a study is published without undergoing rigorous peer review, its scientific claims should be viewed with considerable skepticism.
3. The comparative study analyzed how four different European healthcare models responded to the operational pressures of the pandemic.

---

### 3621. survey /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការស្ទង់មតិ / ការអង្កេត
1. The national demographic survey was administered online and by telephone to capture responses from both urban and rural citizens.
2. If a survey contains ambiguous or leading questions, the resulting data will fail to reflect authentic public opinion.
3. Researchers analyzed responses from an extensive workplace survey to identify factors that contribute to employee burnout.

---

### 3622. experiment /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការពិសោធន៍
1. The physics experiment required absolute zero temperatures to observe quantum entanglement between isolated atomic particles.

3. Psychologists designed an innovative behavioral experiment to investigate how peer pressure affects individual decision-making under stress.

---

### 3623. observation /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការសង្កេត
1. Through careful telescopic observation over several months, astronomers tracked the precise trajectory of the interstellar comet.

3. The teacher's qualitative observation indicated that students participated more actively when group discussion preceded individual writing tasks.

### 3624. finding /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** របកគំហើញ
1. The most surprising finding of the sociological report was that social media usage did not correlate with reported feelings of loneliness.
2. If independent laboratories corroborate the finding, it could lead to an entirely new paradigm in renewable battery technology.
3. The researchers presented their empirical findings at an international symposium attended by world-leading neuroscientists.

---

### 3625. result /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លទ្ធផល
1. The experimental results demonstrated that the ceramic composite retained structural integrity even at temperatures exceeding two thousand degrees.
2. If the clinical trial results do not meet primary efficacy endpoints, regulatory approval will be formally denied.
3. The statistical result confirmed what previous theoretical models had predicted regarding the relationship between interest rates and investment.

### 3626. outcome /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លទ្ធផលចុងក្រោយ
1. The successful outcome of the international peace talks depended heavily on diplomatic compromises made by both negotiating delegations.
2. If hospital administrators focus solely on financial efficiency, patient health outcomes may deteriorate significantly over time.
3. Researchers monitored patient recovery trajectories over twelve months to assess whether early physical therapy improved functional outcomes.

### 3627. sample /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** គំរូតំណាង
1. Because analyzing the entire national populace was impossible, investigators selected a stratified random sample of three thousand voters.
2. If the blood sample is contaminated during extraction, the diagnostic test will generate inaccurate metabolic readings.
3. The demographic sample included participants from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds, geographic regions, and age groups.

---

### 3628. population /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រជាសាស្ត្រគំរូ / ចំនួនប្រជាជនសិក្សា
1. Epidemiological models must account for demographic shifts within the target population when projecting future healthcare demands.
2. If researchers wish to draw inferences about the general population, their study cohort must accurately reflect national diversity.
3. The marine biology survey assessed how rising ocean temperatures have impacted fish populations along the continental shelf.

### 3629. cohort /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ក្រុមមនុស្សដែលសិក្សា
1. The birth cohort born in 1980 was tracked over four decades to study the long-term economic effects of early childhood healthcare.

3. Researchers compared cognitive decline rates between a cohort of bilingual adults and a matched cohort of monolingual peers.

### 3630. control group /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ក្រុមត្រួតពិនិត្យ
1. In order to establish baseline data, the control group received an inert placebo while the experimental group took the active compound.

3. The researchers ensured that the control group was matched with the intervention group in terms of age, gender, and baseline health.

---

### 3631. experimental group /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ក្រុមពិសោធន៍
1. Members of the experimental group demonstrated a thirty percent reduction in symptoms compared to baseline measurements.
2. If members of the experimental group fail to adhere to the prescribed dietary regimen, the validity of the trial will be compromised.
3. The psychological study evaluated whether the experimental group showed superior memory retention after completing mnemonic training.

---

### 3632. qualitative research /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការស្រាវជ្រាវបែបគុណភាព
1. Qualitative research provides deep, contextual insights into human motivations that cannot be captured through standardized numeric surveys.

---

### 3633. quantitative research /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការស្រាវជ្រាវបែបបរិមាណ
1. Quantitative research relies on measurable empirical data and inferential statistics to test formal hypotheses rigorously.

3. The department hired a specialist in quantitative research to teach multivariate regression and computational modeling to graduate students.

---

### 3634. mixed methods /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** វិធីសាស្ត្រចម្រុះ
1. By employing a mixed methods design, the investigators were able to triangulate survey statistics with rich personal interview narratives.
2. If educational researchers use mixed methods, they can evaluate both test score changes and subjective classroom experiences.
3. The grant proposal advocated for mixed methods because neither quantitative surveys nor qualitative interviews alone could resolve the question.

### 3635. primary source /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រភពបឋម
1. Historians examining the Civil War rely extensively on primary sources such as battlefield letters, official diaries, and telegrams.

3. The archival exhibit showcased rare primary sources, including original handwritten drafts of the nation's constitution.

---

### 3636. secondary source /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប្រភពទុតិយភូមិ
1. Textbooks, encyclopedias, and scholarly monographs are typically categorized as secondary sources because they analyze primary evidence.
2. If students cite secondary sources without verifying the claims against original primary texts, they risk repeating misinterpretations.
3. The literature review integrated insights from dozens of secondary sources to summarize contemporary scholarly debates.

---

### 3637. original research /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការស្រាវជ្រាវផ្ទាល់ដើម
1. Doctoral candidates are required to produce original research that makes a distinct intellectual contribution to their chosen academic field.

3. The prestigious award recognized the young scientist's original research into novel semiconductor nanostructures.

---

### 3638. empirical data /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទិន្នន័យជាក់ស្តែងពីការអង្កេត
1. Theoretical models remain speculative until they can be corroborated by rigorous empirical data gathered from laboratory experiments.

### 3639. fieldwork /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការចុះស្រាវជ្រាវផ្ទាល់
1. Anthropologists spent eighteen consecutive months conducting fieldwork in the Amazon basin to document vanishing indigenous languages.

3. The graduate curriculum requires all environmental science majors to complete a six-credit semester of intensive field research.

---

### 3640. case study /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ករណីសិក្សា
1. The professor used an in-depth case study of Enron's collapse to illustrate catastrophic breakdowns in corporate governance.

### 3641. longitudinal study /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការសិក្សារយៈពេលវែង
1. A forty-year longitudinal study demonstrated that early childhood emotional regulation strongly predicts adult financial stability.

3. The Harvard Study of Adult Development represents one of the longest longitudinal studies ever conducted on physical and mental well-being.

### 3642. cross-sectional study /noun/

1. The public health team performed a cross-sectional study to examine dietary habits across different age demographics simultaneously.

### 3643. pilot study /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការសិក្សាសាកល្បង

### 3644. interview /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការសម្ភាសន៍
1. The qualitative sociologist conducted a semi-structured interview with each company executive to explore corporate decision-making norms.

---

### 3645. questionnaire /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កម្រងសំណួរ
1. Researchers distributed a standardized questionnaire to assess job satisfaction, perceived autonomy, and stress levels among nurses.

3. Over eight hundred completed questionnaires were returned, yielding an exceptionally high response rate for an online academic survey.

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ក្រុមពិភាក្សាផ្ដោត

### 3647. participant /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អ្នកចូលរួម
1. Every participant in the clinical study was informed of potential adverse side effects before signing the official consent documentation.

---

### 3648. respondent /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** អ្នកឆ្លើយតប

### 3649. correlation /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សហសម្ព័ន្ធភាព

### 3650. causation /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទំនាក់ទំនងបុព្វហេតុនិងផល

### 3651. trend /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** និន្នាការ

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការបែងចែក / ចែកចាយ

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សេចក្តីសង្ខេបស្រាវជ្រាវ

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សេចក្តីផ្តើម

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការពិនិត្យឡើងវិញនូវអក្សរសិល្ប៍

### 3659. discussion /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការពិភាក្សាដេញដោល

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សេចក្តីសន្និដ្ឋាន

### 3661. reference /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ឯកសារយោង

### 3662. bibliography /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** គន្ថនិទ្ទេស / បញ្ជីឯកសារយោង

### 3663. citation /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការដកស្រង់យោង

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កំណត់សម្គាល់បាតទំព័រ

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សាត្រាស្លឹករឹត / សេចក្តីព្រាងអត្ថបទស្រាវជ្រាវ
1. The editor returned the manuscript to the authors with extensive peer-review comments detailing necessary empirical revisions.
2. If authors do not adhere strictly to the journal's manuscript formatting instructions, their submission may be rejected without review.

### 3672. publication /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការបោះពុម្ពផ្សាយ

3. The institute's latest scientific publication received widespread coverage in mainstream media outlets due to its environmental relevance.

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទស្សនាវដ្តីសិក្សាស្រាវជ្រាវ

**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កាលប្បវត្តិ / ព្រឹត្តិបត្រចេញតាមកាលកំណត់

### 3676. symposium /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សិក្ខាសាលា / សន្និសីទឯកទេស
1. The department hosted an international symposium dedicated entirely to the philosophical implications of artificial neural networks.
2. If prominent specialists participate in a symposium, the resulting published proceedings often define the research agenda for years.
3. During the afternoon symposium session, several leading climatologists debated alternative geo-engineering strategies to counteract warming.

---

### 3677. seminar /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សិក្ខាសាលា
1. Graduate students are expected to lead weekly seminar discussions by analyzing assigned theoretical readings and facilitating debate.
2. If students attend the advanced methodology seminar, they will master practical techniques for conducting multivariate data analysis.
3. The visiting professor conducted an intensive three-day seminar on archival preservation techniques for cultural heritage institutions.

---

### 3678. presentation /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បទបង្ហាញ
1. The postdoctoral fellow delivered a twenty-minute presentation detailing how machine learning could accelerate drug discovery pipelines.
2. If your conference presentation contains too many cluttered slides, the audience will struggle to follow your overarching argument.
3. Following her oral presentation, the speaker answered probing questions from senior researchers regarding her experimental controls.

---

### 3679. keynote /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សុន្ទរកថាគន្លឹះ
1. The Nobel laureate was invited to deliver the opening keynote address on the future of quantum computing technologies.
2. If the keynote speech lacks intellectual substance, participants may feel uninspired during the remainder of the conference program.
3. In her inspiring keynote address, the dean emphasized the imperative for higher education institutions to embrace multidisciplinary research.

---

### 3680. proceedings /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កំណត់ហេតុរបាយការណ៍សន្និសីទ
1. The conference proceedings were published in a peer-reviewed volume indexed by major international scientific databases.
2. If authors fail to submit their final camera-ready papers on time, their contributions will be excluded from the official proceedings.
3. Researchers frequently consult published conference proceedings to learn about ongoing experimental work prior to formal journal publication.

---

### 3681. peer review /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការវាយតម្លៃដោយអ្នកជំនាញដូចគ្នា
1. Rigorous peer review acts as the primary quality control mechanism ensuring that published academic papers meet scientific standards.
2. If a manuscript undergoes thorough peer review, constructive feedback from independent experts typically enhances its argumentative clarity.
3. The ethics board investigated whether the peer review process had been compromised by unrevealed conflicts of interest among referees.

---

### 3682. replication /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការធ្វើឡើងវិញដើម្បីផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
1. Independent replication of experimental findings is essential before any medical intervention can be certified for clinical widespread use.
2. If multiple replication attempts yield contradictory results, the initial scientific consensus must be critically re-examined.
3. The psychological community has placed renewed emphasis on exact replication studies to combat the ongoing reproducibility crisis.

---

### 3683. citation index /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សន្ទស្សន៍ដកស្រង់យោង
1. University promotion committees consult the Science Citation Index to measure the international scholarly impact of a professor's publications.
2. If a paper is indexed in a recognized citation index, its visibility among global researchers increases exponentially.
3. The librarian conducted a bibliometric search using an electronic citation index to evaluate institutional research output across faculties.

---

### 3684. impact factor /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កត្តាជះឥទ្ធិពលនៃទស្សនាវដ្តី
1. Researchers often aim to publish in journals with a high impact factor to maximize the reach and prestige of their academic findings.
2. Although a high impact factor signifies journal prominence, critics argue that it does not always reflect the quality of individual articles.
3. The journal's impact factor rose sharply following the publication of a landmark paper on novel gene-editing methodologies.

---

### 3685. h-index /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សន្ទស្សន៍វាស់វែងសមិទ្ធផលអ្នកស្រាវជ្រាវ
1. A researcher's h-index attempts to quantify both their overall productivity and the citation impact of their published scholarship.
2. If a scientist has an h-index of thirty, it means they have authored at least thirty papers that have each received at least thirty citations.
3. While the h-index is widely used in academic evaluations, many scholars emphasize that it should not replace holistic peer evaluation.

---

### 3686. plagiarism /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ការលួចចម្លងស្នាដៃ
1. Universities enforce strict penalties against plagiarism, ranging from failing individual assignments to permanent expulsion from degree programs.
2. If a student uses another author's written words or intellectual ideas without proper attribution, it constitutes serious academic plagiarism.
3. Automated plagiarism software flagged multiple verbatim passages that had been copied directly from an uncredited online dissertation.

---

### 3687. academic integrity /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សុចរិតភាពក្នុងការសិក្សាស្រាវជ្រាវ
1. Maintaining academic integrity requires honesty in data collection, transparent reporting of methods, and rigorous citation of sources.
2. If an educational institution fails to cultivate a culture of academic integrity, the value of its awarded degrees will be called into question.
3. The university honor council adjudicates all alleged violations of academic integrity with confidentiality and formal due process.

---

### 3688. intellectual property /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** កម្មសិទ្ធិបញ្ញា
1. Universities and corporate research sponsors often sign detailed agreements to establish who owns the resulting intellectual property.
2. If an inventor does not patent their novel technological discovery promptly, they risk forfeiting their intellectual property rights.
3. The legal dispute centered on whether the algorithm developed during graduate research belonged to the student or the university laboratory.

---

### 3689. copyright /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** សិទ្ធិអ្នកនិពន្ធ
1. Under international copyright law, authors retain the exclusive legal right to reproduce and distribute their original scholarly works.
2. If an academic uploads copyrighted journal articles to public file-sharing platforms without permission, it constitutes copyright infringement.
3. Authors publishing under open access agreements typically retain the copyright to their work while granting the public permission to share it.

---

### 3690. open access /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** លទ្ធភាពចូលប្រើប្រាស់ដោយសេរី
1. The open access movement advocates for scientific literature to be freely accessible online to everyone without subscription fees.
2. If publicly funded research is made available through open access publishing, practitioners worldwide can benefit from scientific advances immediately.
3. Many universities have established dedicated funding pools to cover open access processing charges on behalf of faculty authors.

---

### 3691. paywall /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** របាំងបង់ប្រាក់ចូលអាន
1. Many independent researchers cannot access critical scientific literature because prestigious journals keep articles behind an expensive paywall.
2. If scientific discoveries remain behind a paywall, scholars in developing nations face severe structural barriers to conducting research.
3. The initiative aims to dismantle paywalls surrounding publicly financed medical studies, ensuring that clinical knowledge is universal.

---

### 3692. repository /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ឃ្លាំងផ្ទុកទិន្នន័យ / បណ្ណាល័យឌីជីថល
1. Researchers are encouraged to deposit raw datasets in an open institutional repository so that other scientists can verify findings.
2. If a digital repository is not properly maintained and curated, valuable research data may suffer digital obsolescence over time.
3. The university's online repository hosts thousands of master's theses, doctoral dissertations, and faculty conference presentations.

---

### 3693. archive /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ប័ណ្ណសារ
1. Historians spent months exploring the national diplomatic archive to uncover classified correspondence from the Cold War period.
2. If archival documents are not preserved in climate-controlled environments, delicate paper records will deteriorate beyond restoration.
3. The digital archive allows scholars from around the globe to examine high-resolution scans of rare fifteenth-century illuminated manuscripts.

---

### 3694. peer-reviewed journal /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ទស្សនាវដ្តីដែលឆ្លងកាត់ការវាយតម្លៃដោយអ្នកជំនាញ
1. Academic committees place the highest professional value on publications that appear in an internationally recognized peer-reviewed journal.
2. If an article is submitted to a prestigious peer-reviewed journal, it must undergo thorough evaluation by multiple expert reviewers.
3. The young scholar celebrated after receiving confirmation that her article had been accepted by a leading peer-reviewed journal.

---

### 3695. editorial board /noun/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ក្រុមប្រឹក្សាភិបាលនិពន្ធ
1. The journal's editorial board consists of distinguished international researchers who oversee the peer-review policy and ensure academic rigor.
2. If the editorial board resigns in protest over commercial pressures, the academic credibility of the journal will be severely damaged.
3. The editor-in-chief convened a meeting of the editorial board to formulate strategic guidelines regarding manuscripts utilizing generative AI.

---

### 3696. academic /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្នែកសិក្សាស្រាវជ្រាវ / បែបសិក្សា
1. Achieving academic success requires not only raw intellectual capability but also disciplined study habits and effective time management.
2. If a scholar fails to adhere to established academic conventions, their writing may be dismissed as unprofessional or unscholarly.
3. The university introduced an academic mentoring program designed to assist first-generation students in adapting to university life.

---

### 3697. scholarly /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បែបអ្នកប្រាជ្ញ / បែបសិក្សាជ្រៅជ្រះ
1. The professor authored several scholarly monographs that transformed contemporary understanding of medieval economic history.
2. If an article lacks scholarly rigor and rigorous citations, it will not be taken seriously by the wider scientific community.
3. The scholarly debate regarding the causes of the French Revolution has produced voluminous literature over the past two centuries.

---

### 3698. peer-reviewed /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ដែលបានឆ្លងកាត់ការវាយតម្លៃដោយអ្នកជំនាញ
1. Medical practitioners are advised to rely primarily on peer-reviewed evidence when making critical clinical treatment decisions.
2. If research is not published in a peer-reviewed venue, policymakers should treat its conclusions with appropriate scientific caution.
3. The bibliography contained exclusively peer-reviewed sources from leading international journals in sociology and public policy.

---

### 3699. empirical /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ផ្អែកលើការពិសោធន៍ជាក់ស្តែង
1. Philosophers distinguished purely speculative metaphysical theories from empirical claims that can be tested through scientific observation.
2. If an economic theory lacks empirical support from real-world markets, it remains an untested mathematical abstraction.
3. The researchers gathered empirical data from hundreds of clinical patients over five years to evaluate the therapy's long-term efficacy.

---

### 3700. theoretical /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** តាមទ្រឹស្តី
1. Although the mechanism has strong theoretical validity, practical technological hurdles have prevented its successful laboratory implementation.
2. If physicists work exclusively within theoretical frameworks, they may propose concepts that cannot be confirmed through current experimental tools.
3. The graduate course balances theoretical foundations of macroeconomic policy with practical econometric analysis of current data.

### 3701. conceptual /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បែបគំនិត / តាមគោលគំនិត
1. The introductory chapter provides a conceptual framework that helps readers understand the relationship between institutional trust and civic engagement.
2. If students do not grasp the conceptual differences between microeconomics and macroeconomics, advanced quantitative problem-solving will prove challenging.
3. The architect presented a bold conceptual design that reimagined public library spaces as interactive digital learning centers.

---

### 3702. analytical /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បែបវិភាគ
1. Employers across all professional sectors highly value candidates who possess strong analytical skills and can solve complex unstructured problems.
2. If researchers approach the historical archive with rigorous analytical methods, they can uncover previously unnoticed socioeconomic trends.
3. The report presented an analytical breakdown of municipal expenditures over the preceding fiscal decade.

---

### 3703. critical /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** បែបស៊ីជម្រៅនិងរិះគន់ / សំខាន់ចាំបាច់
1. Higher education programs are designed to cultivate critical thinking skills so that graduates can distinguish reliable evidence from propaganda.
2. If clinical trial investigators fail to monitor patient vitals at critical junctures, unexpected adverse events may go unrecorded.
3. The literary scholar published a critical commentary analyzing gender representation in early nineteenth-century Gothic novels.

### 3704. systematic /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** ដែលមានប្រព័ន្ធច្បាស់លាស់
1. A systematic review of existing medical literature synthesizes all published clinical trials to reach a reliable treatment recommendation.
2. If the laboratory does not maintain a systematic protocol for chemical storage, accidental contamination hazards will multiply exponentially.
3. The criminologist conducted a systematic investigation into the root socioeconomic causes of juvenile recidivism in urban centers.

---

### 3705. comprehensive /adjective/
**ន័យខ្មែរ:** គ្រប់ជ្រុងជ្រោយ
1. The health ministry published a comprehensive report detailing national epidemiological trends across all demographic groups.
2. If a literature review is not comprehensive, peer reviewers will quickly identify key foundational publications that the author neglected.
3. The university developed a comprehensive orientation program designed to help international students acclimate to campus culture.
